coordinateSystem.transform: smooth warp from Toril GCS through the existing surface-place control points; sites and region outlines share the map raster pixel frame
coordinateSystem.meaning: regional context only; this is not surveyed cave geometry or a passage network

levelContext.basis: Toril GIS feature_levels classifies the region across these horizons; this is regional membership, not the depth of the lava-tube route.

connections.evidence: A source-backed connection reaches the surface volcanoes. The exact surface entrance and the precise Underdark depth of the connection are not established; GIS lists the Burning Rift across all three horizons, which is not a route trace.

connections.via: underground river flowing toward Lake Thoroot

levelContext.basis: Toril GIS feature_levels classifies this lake; the passage level and Lake Thoroot level are not established by this regional record.

connections.evidence: A named river joins the two lakes. Lake Thoroot has no mapped feature record in this snapshot, and the GIS layer classification for Lake of Shadows does not establish the river route level.

levelContext.basis: Toril GIS feature_levels classifies the Fardrimm region; the full Lowroad route is not assigned a verified depth by this record.

connections.evidence: Source material describes the Lowroad as an underground trade route joining Delzoun and Netheril; this records the named relation, not a traced centerline or depth for the full route.

sources.title: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier

levelContext.basis: Toril GIS feature_levels classifies the city; the source does not locate every portal or establish its depth as route geometry.

connections.evidence: The ten segments are linked by a web of portals; individual portal pairs, coordinates, and route depths are not encoded as exact map edges.

levelContext.basis: Toril GIS classifies the town as Lowerdark; this does not establish the depth or geometry of its passage.

connections.evidence: The Earth's End registry article describes a passage to the Underchasm and cites Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide, p. 226. It does not locate the passage or state its route depth. The town's Lowerdark classification is regional context, not passage geometry or a confirmed surface entrance.

provenance.dataset: Toril GIS public snapshot 2026-09-24_1; unofficial reconstructed cartography
provenance.featureLevelMeaning: feature_levels is the recorded GIS classification of an area or point; it does not prove that a passage follows that level
provenance.positionMeaning: regional positions warped into the HandsomeRob raster pixel frame; not surveyed cave or tunnel geometry
provenance.confidence: Toril GIS source IDs and feature URLs are preserved; no per-feature numeric confidence score is supplied in the source snapshot
limitations: Underdark polygons are regional context, not cave-volume outlines
route-level membership is empty unless a source identifies the route depth
connections with unknown geometry are not drawn as map lines
